feature: A broken icon breaks the way it was asked to
summary: Ask used to bite a chunk out of the upper right of anything breaking, so a broken heart looked bitten and a cracked egg looked eaten. Now the model says how the thing breaks, burst or cracked, and a crack runs right through it: a jagged line through a line drawing, a jagged gap splitting a solid one in two. A burst still tears, and anything that sat in the torn stretch goes with it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Ask with the built-in model. Measured with Scripts/ask-eval.sh on the icon-broken-heart, icon-cracked-egg-filled, icon-soap-bubble-bursting and icon-balloon-popping cases.

try.do: Before: the four breaking icons as they landed this morning, every one torn at the upper right.
Open Ask on a blank picture and type: a broken heart icon.
try.shotNote: The eval's judging sheet, drawn from the app's own render of the icon, not a window capture.

try.do: Ask again with: a cracked egg icon, filled.
try.shotNote: The eval's judging sheet, drawn from the app's own render of the icon, not a window capture.

try.do: Ask again with: an icon of a soap bubble bursting. It still tears.
try.shotNote: The eval's judging sheet, drawn from the app's own render of the icon, not a window capture.

try.do: Ask for something cracked or broken of your own choosing, in a line and filled, and check the crack runs the short way through it.

evaluate: Does the heart read as broken at 16 pixels, the way Lucide's does?
Does the egg split by a jagged gap read as cracked, or would you rather see a crack line on a whole egg?
Is a crack running all the way through right, or should a line drawing's crack stop part way like a hairline?
For a bursting bubble, is a tear at all the right idea, or should a round thing burst some other way?
rough: The soap bubble still tears and still scores low (33 to 36 against 71 for the model drawing its own burst, one reading on 2026-11-05). Four other looks were tried and none beat the tear on the same drawing; the task stays open for it.

The balloon read 55 and 66 this session on the unchanged tear, under its bar of 85; it read 67 to 84 the day before. The model's balloon drawing varies more than the tear does; the task stays open for it.
A request to shatter something is drawn as a crack. A ring of pieces was tried and read as a viewfinder, a sun or a light bulb.
No window captures: the eval drives Ask through walks that take no pictures of the window, so the pictures are the eval's judging sheets.
